comment: restore.c:restgamestate -> role_init() and Sfi_q_score(svq.quest_status). A debug Valkyrie creates her quest nemesis (Lord Surtur, fixed gender, so role_init draws no random number on restore) next to her and saves. The second segment restores, declines to keep the save file, and waits two turns so the nemesis acts: monmove.c:dochug -> quest.c:quest_stat_check reads svq.quest_status after the restore. Seeds and datetimes were chosen independently of every recorded session.
